description: A PHPUnit test class for VacancyListRestController within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It tests API request handling, including GET requests with various parameters and exception cases for unsupported methods.

classes.name: VacancyListRestControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the VacancyListRestController's API GET handling and exception responses.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures by loading a YAML configuration.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequest
methods.description: Tests retrieving vacancy list data and verifies the first item's name.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestCount
methods.description: Tests that the count of vacancy data returned is as expected.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestWithLimit
methods.description: Tests pagination by limiting number of returned vacancies.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestWithOffset
methods.description: Tests pagination by offset and verifies the first returned vacancy's name.

methods.name: testHandlePutRequest
